title: Mob Drops Plus
description: This project aims to add vanilla styled drops for many mobs.
body:
**Mob Drops Plus** aims to add vanilla style drops to mobs such as Bats, Camels, aswell as adding more to the loot table of mobs such as the Husk and the Parched.


<details>
<summary>New Mob Drops</summary>

- **Allays** now drop 0 - 1 Cookies
- **Armadillos** now drop 0 - 1 Armadillo Scute
- **Axolotls** now drop 0 - 4 Tropical Fish
- **Bats** now drop 0 - 2 Bone Meal
- **The Bogged** now drops 0 - 1 Red Mushrooms and / or 0 - 1 Brown Mushrooms
- **Camels** now drop 2 - 4 Leather
- **Drowneds** now drop 2 - 4 Gravel in Cold Oceans, Deep Cold Oceans, Deep Frozen Oceans, Deep Lukewarm Oceans, Deep Oceans, Frozen Oceans, Lukewarm Oceans, Oceans, Warm Oceans, Frozen Rivers and Rivers
- **The Ender Dragon** now drops an Elytra
- **Endermites** now drop 0 - 1 Chorus Fruit
- **Frogs** now drop 0 - 2 Slimeballs
- **Giants** now drop 8 - 12 Rotten Flesh
- **Goats** now drop 1 - 2 Mutton
- **Husks** now drop 2 - 4 Sand in Deserts, Beaches and Snowy Beaches
- **Husks** now drop 2 - 4 Red Sand in Badlands, Eroded Badlands and Wooded Badlands
- **Ocelots** now drop 0 - 2 String and / or 0 - 1 Raw Cod
- **The Parched** now drops 2 - 4 Sand in Deserts, Beaches and Snowy Beaches
- **The Parched** now drops 2 - 4 Red Sand in Badlands, Eroded Badlands and Wooded Badlands
- **Piglins** now drop 1 - 3 Porkchops
- **Piglin Brutes** now drop 1 - 3 Porkchops
- **Ravagers** now drop 0 - 4 Tuff
- **Sniffers** now drop 0 - 1 Moss Blocks
- **Strays** now drop 2 - 4 Snow Blocks in Snowy Beaches, Snowy Plains, Snowy Slopes, Snowy Taigas, Jagged Peaks, Frozen Peaks, Groves, Frozen Oceans, Frozen Rivers, Deep Frozen Oceans and Ice Spikes
- **Turtles** now drop 0 - 3 Turtle Scute
- **Vexes** now drop 0 - 2 Diamonds
- **Wandering Traders** now drop 0 - 2 Emeralds
- **Wardens** now drop 2 - 4 Echo Shards
- **Withers** now drop 2 - 4 Netherite Scrap

</details>


<details>
<summary>Looting Details</summary>

- **Armadillos** Scute drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Axolotls** Tropical Fish drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Bats** Bone Meal drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **The Drowneds** Gravel drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Endermites** Chorus Fruit drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Frogs** Slimeball drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **The Giants** Rotten Flesh drop increases by 0 - 4 per Looting level
- **Goats** Mutton drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Husks** Sand drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Husks** Red Sand drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **The Parcheds** Sand drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **The Parcheds** Red Sand drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Piglins** Porkchop drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Piglin Brutes** Porkchop drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Sniffers** Moss Block drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **The Strays** Snow Block drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Turtles** Scute drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Vexes** Diamond drop increases by 0 - 2 per Looting level
- **Wandering Traders** Emerald drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level
- **Wardens** Echo Shard drop increases by 0 - 1 per Looting level

</details>
